## SCHEDULE A

## September, 1979

Incremental increases will be granted September 1, 1979.

* This phase of the equivalency program is restricted to teachers appointed prior to September 1, 1963. Teachers appointed on or after September 1, 1963 must possess a Masters Degree to be eligible for advanced salary standing.
